_comment: npm audit allowlist — reviewed false positives that do not apply to this project.
_format: Each entry requires: id (GHSA or NPM advisory ID), reason, reviewed_by, reviewed_date, and recheck_after.
_instructions: To suppress a new advisory: add an entry here AND add an 'overrides' field in package.json
pointing the affected package at a safe version (or the same version if no fix exists).
Every entry must be re-evaluated when soroban-sdk, vite, or react bumps a major version.
